args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what was accomplished:

1. **Pre-deploy verification**: Found production running v2.3.1 which was unhealthy (18% error rate) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. v2.3.2 had never been deployed to production.

2. **Deployment**: Shipped v2.3.2 to all three production regions. Since it had never been healthy in production, it required change-manager approval per policy — the approval was granted ("Approved. Looks right.") and the rollout completed.

3. **Post-deploy verification**: All three regions now on v2.3.2, service healthy, error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.

4. **Incident opened**: SEV3 incident **INC-0001** created for checkout-api documenting the hotfix deployment, with the on-call paged.
